theorem not_mem_erase (a : α) (s : Finset α) : a ∉ erase s a :=

theorem ne_of_mem_erase : b ∈ erase s a → b ≠ a := fun h => (mem_erase.1 h).1

  exact not_imp_not.mp hsa hs

  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.trans (erase_subset _ _), fun ha => not_mem_erase _ _ (h ha)⟩,
